paper_title: LaSQuE Improved Zero-Shot Classification from Explanations Through   Quantifier Modeling and Curriculum Learning
caption: Classification accuracy on novel real-world classification tasks in .
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy of several models on novel real-world classification tasks. The horizontal axis displays the categories: RoBERTa w/o Exp., ExEnt, LaSQuE (mean), LaSQuE, LaSQuE (syn2real), and + curriculum, listed in this order. The vertical axis represents accuracy, labeled as "Accuracy (%)", with a linear scale ranging from 40% to 65%, and tick marks at 5% intervals. There are six bars, each corresponding to a model, and they are rendered in different colors: light gray for RoBERTa w/o Exp., light blue for ExEnt, orange for LaSQuE (mean), green for LaSQuE, purple for LaSQuE (syn2real), and dark gray for + curriculum. The RoBERTa w/o Exp. bar extends to approximately 46%, while the + curriculum bar reaches nearly 64%. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and none are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlines, or annotations.
